'''Shayl Tasao''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as the representative of the [[Exchange]] consortium on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], she enlisted the help of an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] individual to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Ghar Bodya]]. Bodya was defeated at the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and as proof of his death the individual in question took his head off and showed it to Tasao, who gave him a reward with [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="TOR" />

She complained about the terrible smell of the [[Houk/Legends|Houk's]] head and commented she should have taken a refrigerator unit to store it, but instead disposed of it down a garbage chute.<ref name="TOR" />
